raw_response: Banks reported that the FDIC special assessment significantly increased their non-interest expenses. Specifically, one bank noted a $1.9 billion charge included in its 2023 non-interest expense total, while another cited a large charge in the fourth quarter of 2023 and an additional roughly $500 million year-to-date impact on operating losses in the first half of 2024 compared to prior run-rates. Some banks also noted that excluding these special assessment charges, their underlying expenses still increased due to other factors such as higher revenue-related compensation, investments in technology and personnel, and severance costs.
